name: Fuji Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Fuji Electric Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops power semiconductors and electronics solutions in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Energy, Industry, Semiconductors, and Food and Beverage Distribution segments. The company also offers drivers and controls including AC drives, motors, servo systems, programmable logic controllers, and human machine interface; power supply products, which includes uninterruptible power systems, solar inverters, data centers, regulators, rectifiers, and formers; sensors and measurements, such as instrumentation and radiation monitoring systems; and monitoring and control systems.
